The math, step by step

DEGREES
Why components?

Forces are vectors. Add their signed x and y components—not just their magnitudes.

Same resultant. Two geometric rules.

Parallelogram rule
Place both forces tail-to-tail. The diagonal is the resultant.

Triangle rule
Move B so its tail meets A’s tip without rotating it. The resultant runs from A’s tail to B’s tip.

Angle matters
The included angle is the angle between the two forces. It is not necessarily either force’s angle from +x.
